overview.description: The iShares MSCI Netherlands ETF (EWN) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI Netherlands IMI 25-50 index, a market-cap-weighted index of Dutch firms. EWN was launched on Mar 12, 1996 and is issued by BlackRock.
